_comment: Pinned SHA-256 digests of the GitHub source tarball, one per release.
A local pin is the stronger, reviewed value and takes precedence. When a
version has no entry here, the panel falls back to the SOURCE_SHA256
asset published on that GitHub Release. If neither exists, the update is
How to publish a release digest:
3. attach the generated SOURCE_SHA256 to the GitHub Release
4. optional: add the same hex value below, in a reviewed commit, to
make it a local pin that takes precedence
A self-hosted fork that never publishes to GitHub Releases can set
NEXUS_UPDATE_ALLOW_UNVERIFIED=1 in backend/.env instead, which restores
the unverified flow with an explicit warning in the logs.
